related.title: 蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統改以乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation; The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex centers on dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Olkaria兩相資源與Geysers蒸汽儲層，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以公園生態與證據為起點，設計一項能區分「兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力」與「乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare olkaria two-phase resources with geysers steam reservoir and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from park ecology/evidence and propose an observation distinguishing two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation from dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment, including uncertainty.

related.title: 懷拉基地熱電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；懷拉基地熱電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Silica supersaturation and scaling" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wairakei Geothermal Power Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦東非大裂谷的地熱基地：井口機組、全國電力占比、蒸汽管線的膨脹與鑽井成功率；懷拉基地熱電站則以第一座開發熱水型熱儲的電廠與它六十年的後果：二級閃發、出力曲線、下陷與排熱為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A geothermal base in the East African Rift: wellhead units, share of national power, expansion of steam mains and drilling success; Wairakei Geothermal Power Station centres on the first plant on a hot-water reservoir and sixty years of consequences: second flash, output curves, subsidence and discharged heat, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「單井出力」的模型移到懷拉基地熱電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「地層壓密與下陷」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Output per well" to Wairakei Geothermal Power Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Formation compaction and subsidence", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；懷拉基地熱電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Silica supersaturation and scaling" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wairakei Geothermal Power Station must be respecified.

related.title: 雙循環地熱發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Silica supersaturation and scaling" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦東非大裂谷的地熱基地：井口機組、全國電力占比、蒸汽管線的膨脹與鑽井成功率；雙循環地熱發電系統則以用七十幾度的溫水發電：冷源的重要、工質壓力比、工質流量、泵功與取代的柴油為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A geothermal base in the East African Rift: wellhead units, share of national power, expansion of steam mains and drilling success; Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems centres on generating from water at seventy-odd degrees: the cold sink, working-fluid pressure ratio, fluid flow, pump work and diesel displaced, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「單井出力」的模型移到雙循環地熱發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「工質泵的耗功」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Output per well" to Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Work of the feed pump", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Silica supersaturation and scaling" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 奧卡里亞地熱電站
history.text: 奧卡里亞地熱電站的公開資料展示兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations illustrate two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型

history.text: 本課將兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
